metadata.provenance: Assessment orchestration record; AppCAT failed before producing report data.

cloudReadiness.details: The Linux runner lacks the Visual Studio legacy ASP.NET WebApplication build targets required to load the project. AppCAT also reported: Msbuild was not found. No cloud-readiness findings were generated; an empty incidents array is not evidence of readiness.
cloudReadiness.remediation: Rerun the core assessment on Windows with Visual Studio MSBuild, ASP.NET web build tools, .NET Framework 4.8 targeting pack, and restored NuGet packages.

dotnetUpgrade.error: The imported project Microsoft.WebApplication.targets was not found.
dotnetUpgrade.details: The MCP assessment generated the five expected output files, but assessment.json contains zero analyzed projects. The generated zero counts do not establish package or API compatibility.
dotnetUpgrade.remediation: Rerun the .NET 10 assessment on Windows with the legacy ASP.NET WebApplication build targets and .NET Framework 4.8 targeting pack installed.

properties.description: PARTIAL ASSESSMENT: core cloud-readiness analysis was blocked because the Linux runner lacks Microsoft.WebApplication.targets. No cloud-readiness conclusion can be drawn. Security and .NET upgrade assessment statuses are recorded separately.
